title_alternatives: The $404K Number Your Realtor Never Shows You
HOA Fees Are Hiding a $404,000 Price Tag
youtube_short.description: Your realtor shows you the mortgage, property taxes, even the insurance estimate — but they never show you what your HOA fee actually costs over 30 years. At $330/month average nationally, that's $118,800 in fees alone. Invested at 7% instead? That's $404,000. Before you buy in any HOA community, ask for 5 years of meeting minutes and the reserve fund balance. That one question could save you everything. #HOA #realestate #homebuying #personalfinance #moneytips
